# ForgeMesh Labs
> ForgeMesh Labs publishes production-running MCP servers, x402-paid APIs, commercial intelligence services, affiliate routing, and machine-readable discovery surfaces for agent commerce.

## Primary Site
- Website: https://forgemesh.io
- X: https://x.com/forgemeshlabs
- Machine index: https://forgemesh.io/index.json
- OpenAPI discovery: https://forgemesh.io/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://forgemesh.io/sitemap.xml

## MCP Packages
- coinopai-mcp: https://www.npmjs.com/package/coinopai-mcp
- forgemesh-imagegen: https://www.npmjs.com/package/forgemesh-imagegen
- @forgemeshlabs/disruption-intelligence-mcp: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forgemeshlabs/disruption-intelligence-mcp
- affiliate-router-mcp: https://www.npmjs.com/package/affiliate-router-mcp
- @forgemeshlabs/travel-assistant-mcp: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@forgemeshlabs/travel-assistant-mcp
- forgemesh: https://www.npmjs.com/package/forgemesh

## Hosted x402 APIs
- CoinOpAI x402 API: https://x402.coinopai.com
- ImageGen x402 API: https://imagegen.coinopai.com
- Disruption Intelligence API: https://disruption.forgemesh.io
  - Discovery: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/index.json
  - OpenAPI: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/openapi.json
  - x402 metadata: https://disruption.forgemesh.io/.well-known/x402.json
  - Product: DisruptionIntel by ForgeMesh Labs
  - Flagship: Disruption Intelligence Ripple Report
  - Scope: source-linked WARN and workforce disruption intelligence with downstream business-ripple analysis
  - Paid endpoints: 23 endpoints from $0.01-$0.25 per call on Base mainnet
  - Categories: event severity, event history, relationships, timelines, company intelligence, company search, radius search, territory disruption, regional summaries, jurisdiction activity, watchlist previews, Ripple Signals, Ripple Paths, and Ripple Reports
- Fare Intelligence API: https://travel.forgemesh.io
